# TftpdR 0.3.1

Patch release for the read-only TFTP (RFC 1350) server and native [Slint](https://slint.dev/) desktop panel. It renames the two shipped executables, stops putting a standalone `.ico` file in the release archives, and fixes the recent-root drop-down (unreliable hover and slow clicks) plus UTF-8 BOM handling for `recent-dirs.txt`. The TFTP protocol, TOML configuration format, read-only behaviour and server security defaults are unchanged.

**中文摘要**：0.3.1 是补丁版本。CLI daemon 可执行文件更名为 `tftpd-r-server`，桌面面板更名为 `tftpd-r`；发布压缩包不再附带独立的 `.ico` 文件。同时修复了最近根目录菜单每 200 ms 重建模型导致的悬停丢失/慢点击无效，以及 `recent-dirs.txt` 的 UTF-8 BOM 容错。TFTP 协议、TOML 配置格式、只读行为和服务端安全默认值不变。

## Downloads

| Platform | Archive |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x86_64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.3.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Windows arm64 (MSVC) | `tftpd-r-0.3.1-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc.zip` |
| Linux x86_64 (glibc) | `tftpd-r-0.3.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |
| Linux arm64 (glibc) | `tftpd-r-0.3.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` |

Every archive contains `tftpd-r-server` (headless daemon), `tftpd-r` (desktop panel), `config.example.toml`, `README.md`, `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`. Archives no longer contain a separate `.ico` file. `SHA256SUMS` covers all release assets.

## Breaking change: executable names

| Role | 0.3.0 and earlier | 0.3.1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headless daemon | `tftpd-r` | `tftpd-r-server` |
| Desktop panel | `tftpd-r-gui` | `tftpd-r` |

Update scripts, shortcuts, service definitions and deployment manifests that start the daemon to invoke `tftpd-r-server`. In particular, `tftpd-r` is now the GUI, so an unchanged daemon command line would open the panel instead of serving in the foreground. The Cargo package names are unchanged (`tftpd-r-daemon` and `tftpd-r-gui-slint`), so `cargo run -p` commands are unaffected.

## What changed

### Executable rename

- The daemon crate now builds a binary named `tftpd-r-server`; its `--help`, `--version` and clap usage text use the new name.
- The GUI crate now builds a binary named `tftpd-r`; its `--help` and `--version` output use the new name.
- The daemon CLI integration tests invoke the renamed binary through `CARGO_BIN_EXE_tftpd-r-server`.

### Release archives

- The packaging step copies `tftpd-r-server` and `tftpd-r` instead of the old names.
- The separate `tftpd-r-gui.ico` copy was removed from the Windows packaging step, and the workflow now fails if an `.ico` file appears in the staged archive directory.
- The Windows executables still embed the product icon as a PE resource; only the standalone file is no longer shipped.

### Recent-root menu stability

- The status-bar recent-root drop-down rebuilt its Slint model on every 200 ms UI tick even when nothing had changed. Slint treats that as a model reset: it destroys and recreates every row, so hover disappeared immediately and a press/release that crossed a tick no longer selected a directory. The model is now replaced only when the visible rows change (path, leaf name or current marker).
- `recent-dirs.txt` now goes through the same UTF-8 BOM-stripping reader as the other state files, so a history file saved by an editor with a BOM no longer loses its first (most recent) entry.
- Regression tests cover both behaviours. No protocol, configuration or security-default code changed.

### Protocol and configuration unchanged

- TFTP RRQ behaviour, option negotiation, path sandbox, resource limits, TOML schema and security defaults are unchanged.
- Existing `config.toml` files remain valid.
- Uploads remain disabled; the server remains read-only.

## Compatibility and security

- The only compatibility break is the executable rename described above.
- `tftpd-r-server` accepts the same CLI arguments, exit codes, environment variables and configuration as the old daemon binary.
- `tftpd-r` starts the same embedded-mode panel as the old GUI binary; root-directory and appearance state files are unchanged. The only behavioural changes are the recent-root menu hover/click fix and the BOM tolerance described above.
- No new network surface, privilege, upload path or default-listener change was introduced.

## Verification status

- Local Windows 11 / Rust 1.100.0 / GNU x64:
  - `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passed.
  - `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --offline -- -D warnings` passed.
  - `cargo test --workspace --locked --offline` passed: **213 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored** (the ignored test opens the native folder dialog).
  - `cargo build --workspace --release --locked --offline` passed; `tftpd-r-server.exe --version` and `tftpd-r.exe --help` report `0.3.1`; the release GUI smoke test printed its startup language/theme line and exited normally.
  - GNU x64 release sizes: `tftpd-r-server.exe` 1,063,936 bytes; `tftpd-r.exe` 9,036,800 bytes (512 bytes above the previous 0.3.1 candidate build).
  - A local archive staging check contained `tftpd-r-server.exe`, `tftpd-r.exe`, `config.example.toml`, `README.md` and both licenses, with **no** `.ico` file.
- The tag-triggered workflow builds all four targets and creates or updates the GitHub Release with those archives and `SHA256SUMS`. A successful CI build does not establish runtime behaviour on every target.
- Not verified by this local run: MSVC interactive GUI, Linux/arm64 runtime, real/legacy TFTP client interoperability, LAN/firewall/TID behaviour, privileged-port deployment, RDP, IME, accessibility and other DPIs. See `docs/testing.md` for the verification matrix.

Linux binaries use the runner's glibc; build from source on older distributions if necessary. The GUI requires an X11/Wayland desktop session; the daemon does not.

## Checksums

`SHA256SUMS` is attached to the release; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` or `Get-FileHash` on Windows.
